prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 9 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: APARTMENT CORRIDOR, Night, warm interior corridor light.
Image 1: the character sheet of 路少泽 (28), look S1
Image 2: the character sheet of 林青羽 (21), look S2
Image 3: the character sheet of 纪然 (27), look S3
Image 4: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 5: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 7: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 8: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 9: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 10: the prop grocery bag full of greens; use only structure, material, and color
Image 11: the prop black handbag; use only structure, material, and color
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: In the short corridor there is one walnut apartment door, Ji Ran's, set in the cream wall panels, with a runner rug along the stone floor and wall sconces glowing on both walls. Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu stand side by side on the runner rug with their backs to Ji Ran's apartment door. Lin Qingyu's right arm is around Ji Ran's waist, and the grocery bag full of greens hangs from his left hand. Ji Ran holds the black handbag on her shoulder. Lu Shaoze stands on the runner rug one step in front of them, facing Ji Ran's apartment door, and glares at Lin Qingyu's arm. The camera stays on the side of the cream wall opposite Ji Ran's apartment door and sees the three in profile.
Panel 1: Wide shot, slow push in, eye-level, camera on the wall opposite Ji Ran's door, the three in profile. Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu stand in front of Ji Ran's apartment door, his arm around her waist and the grocery bag full of greens in his other hand. Lu Shaoze faces them on the runner rug and fixes his eyes on Lin Qingyu's arm.
Panel 2: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, over Lin Qingyu's shoulder onto Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze jerks his chin at the arm around Ji Ran, and his mouth twists with contempt.
Panel 3: Medium shot, handheld, eye-level, framing Lin Qingyu and Ji Ran in front of her door. Lin Qingyu smiles brightly, takes his right arm from Ji Ran's waist and holds his right hand out toward Lu Shaoze.
Panel 4: Medium close-up, slow push in on Lin Qingyu, eye-level. Lin Qingyu keeps his hand extended and smiles sweetly at Lu Shaoze, with the grocery bag full of greens swinging at his side.
Panel 5: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Ji Ran. Ji Ran slides her eyes sideways toward Lin Qingyu, and the corner of her mouth twitches as she holds back a smile.
Panel 6: Medium shot, slight low angle, handheld, on Lin Qingyu. Lin Qingyu tilts his head with mock innocence and waves his free hand toward Ji Ran's apartment door.
Panel 7: Close-up, quick push in, eye-level, on Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze stares at the offered hand without taking it, and his jaw clenches. Out of focus behind him, Lin Qingyu lowers the hand and puts his arm back around Ji Ran's waist.
Panel 8: Medium close-up, over-the-shoulder shot past Ji Ran onto Lu Shaoze, eye-level. Lu Shaoze leans toward Ji Ran and presses a hand to his own chest.
Panel 9: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, two-shot of Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu with Lu Shaoze's pointing arm in the foreground. Lu Shaoze jabs a finger at Lin Qingyu, who stays close beside Ji Ran in front of her door with his arm around her waist.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
